'''Obroa-skai''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa-skai system]] within a strategic position in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==Description==
Ecologically, the world was a terrestrial mix of tundras, mountains, grasslands and deserts. Its days lasted 26 standard hours, and its orbit took 456 local days.

The reputation that had developed over the centuries was that the complete knowledge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had been gathered within the [[Computer/Legends|computers]] of Obroa-skai's information repositories. Obroa-skai was also home to a large collection of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-related antiquities which were destroyed by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].

==History==
In [[16,782 BBY]], the [[Celebratus Archive]] was founded on Obroa-skai with the goal of collecting the complete data records of over 300,000 [[Species/Legends|species]], providing a boon to scholars and ensuring the planet's reputation as a library world.<ref name="TEA" /> A [[Jedi academy|Jedi training academy]] was also founded on the planet no later than [[990 BBY]], specializing in data collection and analysis.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Obroa-skai had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. However, it was abandoned by the Empire during the [[5 ABY/Legends|following year]],<ref name="TEA" /> and by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], it was considered to be a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Obroan]]s kept their planet neutral during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], despite heavy petitioning by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. Obroa-skai's [[Celebratus Archive|expansive library]] of galactic information and numerous academic institutions drew [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Obroa-skai information raid|raid]] its central computer system. The data acquired gave Thrawn the hidden location of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], while the raid also served as part of a distraction technique used on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces prior to the [[Battle of Sluis Van]].

Obroa-skai was [[First Battle of Obroa-skai|captured]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the Galaxy, and a [[yammosk]] was installed in the planet's mantle. Much was lost from the archives, but hardcopies of key items were saved before the assault. The Yuuzhan Vong kept many of the copies intact, at least until they could fully translate them. As such, much of the planet's buildings were kept intact, despite heavy [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]] on other areas of the world. Obroa-skai was later [[Second Battle of Obroa-skai|liberated]] from the Vong, and the yammosk was destroyed.

In [[43 ABY]], Obroa-skai was recovering from the Yuuzhan Vong War and the resultant terraforming on its surface. Institutions such as the [[Aurora Medical Facility]] were in operation as of this time.

==Behind the scenes==
===Mistakes and inconsistencies===
The planet's name is repeatedly misspelled as "Obra-skai" in ''[[Before the Storm]]''. ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' likewise misspells the planet as "Obra-Skai."

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Obroa-skai in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The Fakir sector is actually located in the [[Bakchou arm]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].
